tasks.title: Add per-key rate limiting to the public API and give the search endpoint its own tighter limit
tasks.objective: Add per-key rate limiting to the public API so one client can't starve the others. Over the limit, return 429 with a Retry-After header. The /search endpoint is much heavier than the rest, so it needs its own, tighter limit, and the limits should be configurable per environment without a deploy.
tasks.status: Throttle class written and applied to the three public viewsets; 14 new tests pass. The /search limit is set to 60 a minute, the settings read from the environment, and the docs updated. Needs a final decision on burst allowance before finishing.

messages.body: Add per-key rate limiting to the public API so one client can't starve the others. Over the limit, return 429 with a Retry-After header.
I'll start by reading how the API views are set up, then add a throttle class keyed on the API key.
Sounds good. Keep the default at 120 a minute.

Done: the throttle class is written and applied to the three public viewsets.

Tests pass — 14 new ones cover the limit, the 429 response and the Retry-After header.
Give /search its own limit of 60 a minute.
The /search endpoint now has its own scope at 60 a minute, and the settings read both limits from the environment so you can change them without a deploy.
Docs updated. Should clients get a burst of 10 above the limit, or none?
